quotes.text: The .none-mode-selected class should be applied to the tags container

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: subtest_assert_tags_visibility compares the class state with !isVisible, but its constant message always says the class should be applied. The accepted visible-branch call expects the class absent while its diagnostic says the opposite. The button assertions use separate visible/hidden messages. This is a specific source diagnostic mismatch, not a reproduced failure or a test repair.
title: The tag visibility class diagnostic disagrees with its visible branch
